_comment: THE SIDEBAR NAME'S TINT SCHEDULE (owner request, 2026-11-08). A finished
workspace's name holds its status tone unchanged for hold_seconds after
its last turn ended, then fades to its resting grey over fade_seconds
webapp/src/styles.css). The keyframe percentages are hold/(hold+fade) =
66.667% static; change the numbers here and the keyframes together.
This is independent of the page hold (proto/vocab/page-hold.json).
